# Mutation testing targets (ADR 0101).
#
# One line per package: <package dir> <tier> <efficacy floor>.
#
# Efficacy is killed / (killed + lived) as gremlins reports it, after the
# survivors listed in accepted.txt are taken out. The floor is the measured
# efficacy rounded down to a whole number. Raise it when a run measures a
# higher number; lower it only in a change that says why on the line above.
# A floor of "-" reports without gating, for a package not measured yet.
#
# Tier 1 is the core (target 80%). Every other package under internal/ and
# pkg/ that scripts/coverage-gate.sh counts is tier 2 (target 65%), listed
# here once measured; `scripts/mutation.sh packages 2` lists them all.
#
# Measured on 2026-11-01 at main f2c70c14 with gremlins v0.6.0 and the unit
# tests (no database). internal/storage reaches few of its mutants that way:
# most of its code is tested by the integration suite (ADR 0101 section 6).
# A "-" below is a package whose first full run had not finished; the first
# weekly run sets it.
